info.name: Deck ↔ GitHub Projects Sync
info.summary: Synchronize Nextcloud Deck boards with GitHub Projects v2
info.description:
Bidirectional, per-board and per-field configurable sync between Nextcloud Deck and GitHub Projects (v2).
* Deck board ↔ GitHub Project v2 (org/user) * Stack ↔ Status field option, Card ↔ DraftIssue/Issue * Title, description, labels, assignees, due date, comments * GitHub App (installation token) + optional user PAT * Webhook (projects_v2_item, issues) + background job fallback
info.author: Nextcloud contributors
